evidence.note: Eyebrow '01 · OUTPUT' and top-right 'Output' chip use a dark green ink tone for text.
The '71%' figure is set in the bright lime-green accent as the focus number.
The explanatory caption 'Share of weekday daytime electricity from the panels in the first year' is body text set in the same bright accent green, not the darker ink tone.
Same at the small size: the caption body text is in bright accent green while the eyebrow uses the darker green ink.

rationale: The deck has a darker accent-ink tone for green text (eyebrow, chip), yet the bright accent is also used as the colour for an ordinary caption sentence. Colouring a supporting label in the focus accent is decorative use outside its role and dilutes the focus on the figure. That matches the fail descriptor.
